Sample Extricator

From Helldivers Wiki
Jump to navigation Jump to search
Boosters
Sample Extricator
“

Large enemies now have a chance of dropping Samples on death. Capped at 10 drops per mission.

— Armory Description

Sample Extricator is a Booster in Helldivers 2. When equipped, all Large Enemies will have a chance of dropping Common samples upon death. The amount varies, but the amount dropped per mission is capped at 10.

Procurement

The Sample Extricator Booster is unlocked on the 3rd page of the Borderline Justice Premium Warbond for 65 Medals.

Tactical Information

  • This booster is an effect that's active throughout a mission, which allows a Helldiver-squad to obtain more common samples than the maximum spawning number.
  • This booster is most useful on Evacuate High-Value Assets, Eradicate Terminid Swarm and Eradicate Automaton Forces, where the map is small and/or spawns are at known locations. This makes finding the samples relatively easy. It is beneficial if the squad has Helldivers who need to farm them for Super Destroyer upgrades.
    • Evacuate High-Value Assets normally does not contain samples (2 at most) so extracting with 10 additional samples can be a big help. The samples can often be found in a few minutes by checking the Defense Gate after the mission has been completed.
    • Both eradication missions for the Terminids and Automaton do come with a few samples, but adding 10 can still double the amount of samples found, finding them takes a bit more effort but due to the small map size these can also be found with relative ease.
  • This booster does not perform well on lower difficulties where Large Enemies do not spawn at all, or in low quantities.
  • In terms of the Galactic War, it is beneficial for Sample MOs, where an increase in their collection is important in progressing it. An additional 10 common samples can mean a three-mission operation can potentially yield the same amount as four* missions. (Depending on the difficulty, the extra amount varies)
